name: example-motion-pocketsflow-creator-store
title: Pocketsflow Creator Store
description: A Pocketsflow promo moving from creator products to a mobile store, checkout automation and a halftone brand close.

description_i18n.en: A Pocketsflow promo moving from creator products to a mobile store, checkout automation and a halftone brand close.
description_i18n.zh-CN: Pocketsflow 用网点男孩串联课程、电子书与应用商品、手机商店、自动结账和品牌收尾。

query.en: Make a 15-second creator-commerce promo for {{brand}}. On white, a curly-haired halftone boy whispers “psst…” while {{hookLine}} appears above {{hookPrefix}} and the blue italic {{hookWord}}; the dot expands into blue. Three tall white cards stagger beside the boy: {{course}} at {{coursePrice}} with {{courseImage}}, {{ebook}} at {{ebookPrice}} with {{ebookImage}}, and {{app}} at {{appPrice}} with {{appImage}}. Sweep back to white: {{brand}} {{storePrefix}} / {{storeLine}} / {{storeEnd}} {{storeAccent}} appears at left; a black-framed phone at right fills a blue {{storeName}} page with {{courseTitle}}, {{ebookTitle}}, and {{appTitle}}. A pointer clicks Get it now and the camera pushes through Apple Pay. Pull out into a checkout grid: a card number types in, a ${{monthly}} monthly subscription fills its month markers, {{workbookTitle}} appears with {{workbookImage}}, taxes are checked, payouts count up, Paid lands, and a blue outlined {{handled}} stamp covers the board. On black, the boy keeps performing beside {{flowYou}} {{flowCreate}} and {{flowWe}} {{flowWord}}, mixing large sans lettering with italic accents. A circular wipe returns to white; {{logoImage}} builds the {{brand}} wordmark, the boy peeks above it, {{tagline}} {{tagAccent}} appears, then {{cta}}, {{domain}}, and {{footer}} close the film. Use {{primary}} for blue accents, {{headingFont}} for headings and {{bodyFont}} for running text.
query.zh-CN: 为 {{brand}} 制作约 15 秒的创作者商品宣传片。白底上，卷发网点男孩以“psst…”气泡开场，依次出现 {{hookLine}}、{{hookPrefix}} 与蓝色斜体 {{hookWord}}，问号圆点扩张成蓝底。男孩旁三张白色长卡错峰弹入，分别为 {{course}}、{{coursePrice}}、图片 {{courseImage}}；{{ebook}}、{{ebookPrice}}、图片 {{ebookImage}}；{{app}}、{{appPrice}}、图片 {{appImage}}。画面扫回白底，左侧显示 {{brand}} {{storePrefix}}、{{storeLine}}、{{storeEnd}} {{storeAccent}}，右侧黑框手机填入蓝色 {{storeName}} 页面及 {{courseTitle}}、{{ebookTitle}}、{{appTitle}} 三项商品。光标点击 Get it now，镜头推进 Apple Pay，再拉远展开结账网格：输入卡号，${{monthly}} 月费和月份节点逐个点亮，带 {{workbookImage}} 的 {{workbookTitle}} 加购卡出现，税项打勾，到账数字上涨，按钮变为 Paid，蓝框斜体 {{handled}} 大印章落下。黑底上男孩继续眨眼、点头，旁边大字先显示 {{flowYou}} {{flowCreate}}，再显示 {{flowWe}} {{flowWord}}，无衬线与斜体穿插。圆形白色擦除后，用 {{logoImage}} 组成 {{brand}} 品牌字，男孩从上方探头，依次显示 {{tagline}} {{tagAccent}}、{{cta}}、{{domain}} 及 {{footer}}。蓝色强调使用 {{primary}}，标题使用 {{headingFont}}，正文使用 {{bodyFont}}。
